fun_facts: As a high-schooler in Gainesville, Deshaun Watson got a ball-boy job with the Falcons through the Boys & Girls Club. He helped with practice balls and equipment and folded towels.

In his first start at Clemson, true freshman Deshaun Watson threw for 435 yards and a school-record six touchdowns; those six TD passes also set an ACC record for a quarterback making his starting debut.
Deshaun Watson led Clemson to a 32–3 record as a starter and the 2016 national championship, winning it with a touchdown pass on his final college throw.
In the national championship game against Alabama, Deshaun Watson accounted for 483 total yards and four touchdowns.
Deshaun Watson won the Manning Award as college football’s top quarterback and set ACC records in 2015 with 5,209 yards of total offense and 47 total touchdowns.

basis.reasoning: ESPN’s biography lists Clemson as Deshaun Watson’s college.

excerpts:
True freshman quarterback Deshaun Watson made his first start for Clemson on Saturday, and he set the bar quite high.

Watson threw for 435 yards and a school-record six touchdowns as the Tigers whipped North Carolina, 50-35. The six TD passes also set an ACC record for any league quarterback making his starting debut.

He finished 27-of-36 (75 percent), and six of his completions went to sophomore wide receiver [Mike Williams](https://www.nfl.com/player/mikewilliams/2508048/profile) ; those receptions were good for 122 yards and two touchdowns. Clemson finished with 528 total yards and was 10-of-18 on third-down conversions.

excerpts:
In two-plus seasons as the starter, Watson led Clemson to a 32-3 record and its first national championship in 35 years in the 2016 season. The Tigers rallied to beat Alabama on Watson's game-winning touchdown pass on his final college throw.

Swinney said then that NFL teams that passed on Watson in the draft would come to regret it.

## [Deshaun Watson](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3122840/deshaun-watson) , [Houston Texans](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/hou/houston-texans)

**Draft:** 2017 **Pick:** No. 12

Watson had a key role in the [Clemson Tigers](https://www.espn.com/college-football/team/_/id/228/clemson-tigers) ending their 35-year national championship drought.

He accounted for 5,222 total yards and 50 touchdowns as Clemson finished 14-1. Against Alabama in the national title game, Watson had 483 total yards and four touchdowns.

The Texans selected Watson at No. 12 after trading up from No. 25.

Three days after showing the nation why he's the most dynamic quarterback in college football, Clemson quarterback Deshaun Watson received the hardware to prove it.

The Tigers' sophomore has won the Manning Award, the only major award to withhold its results until after the postseason, as CFB's top quarterback. Watson piled up 478 yards of total offense against Alabama in the College Football Playoff title game on Monday night, a 45-40 loss for the Tigers.
